column1: NOTE 1:When in dBm/15kHz, the minimum Io condition is expressed as the average Io per RE over all REs in that symbol. Io may be different in different symbols within a subframe.NOTE 2:Ts is the basic timing unit defined in TS 36.211.NOTE 3:The same bands and the same Io conditions for each band apply for this requirement as for the corresponding requirement with downlink bandwidth ≥1.4 MHz.NOTE 4:E-UTRA operating band groups are as defined in Section 3.5.
